# antigravity.google documentation — Docs — Sdk

> 8 page(s) of antigravity.google documentation — Docs under Sdk. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Sdk

- [Google Antigravity SDK](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/overview/): The Google Antigravity SDK is a Python SDK for building autonomous AI agents powered by Antigravity and Gemini.
- [Personas and system instructions](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/personas/): The SDK allows you to customize your agent’s identity, behavioral constraints, and instructions using templated or custom system instructions.
- [Custom tools and agent skills](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/tools/): The SDK lets you extend your agent’s capabilities using [custom Python functions](https://antigravity.google#custom-python-functions), built-in web tools, built-in system tools,…
- [Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/mcp/): Connect external Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to your Antigravity SDK agents.
- [Safety policies and permissions](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/policies/): The SDK provides a declarative policy engine for controlling tool execution and requesting human approval.
- [Multi-agent subagent delegation](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/subagents/): Orchestrate complex tasks across specialized subagents with isolated toolsets and execution contexts.
- [Outputs, inputs, and streaming](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/structured-output/): The SDK supports multimodal input attachments, real-time response streaming, and Pydantic schema validation for structured JSON output.
- [Lifecycle hooks, triggers, and session persistence](https://antigravity.google/docs/sdk/lifecycle/): The SDK provides mechanisms for background event scheduling, session state persistence, lifecycle hooks, and token cost auditing.
